scope: Read-only source review; no launch or certificate execution. Root corrections in progress.

findings.detail: Take ps and registrations consistently: a registration created after ps but before lock acquisition must not be retired as an absent group.

Shutdown must signal known registered groups with surviving members after leader exit, using member birth identities. Volatile command text changes across preexec/exec and cannot alone establish different process identity.
Replay copied-inputs.json identities before admission; adapted guard/suite use current source manifest. Include helper binary otherwise excluded from target-helper inventory.
Earlier reviewed parallel proposal required both mutant ceilings plus10GiB free. Preserve that explicit admission minimum alongside reserved-growth plus8GiB steady floor.
